addedControl: The sixth case additionally proves replacement DOM installed during invalidation cleanup survives; it was added after the original five-case negative run.
semantics: Detached preparation cancellation aborts its owner signal.
Committed owners detach from the preparation signal and abort child-first on departure, invalidation or disposal.
Fresh ownership is registered before custom-element connection callbacks run.
Invalidation removes old DOM before user cleanup can create replacement content.
